basic_info.description: Perched atop the iconic Mullen Buildings, this top-floor, two-level penthouse loft boasts two versatile bedrooms and one and a half baths, offering a rare fusion of history and modern design. Vaulted ceilings and an expansive statement window flood the space with natural light, while the private balcony provides a peek at Twin Peaks. This open-concept live/work space blends style and function fluidly, while the private loft-level bedroom offers a secluded retreat. Originally designed by architect George Hauser, this 2002 addition features radiant heat concrete floors, a gas stove, and a fresh air intake system crafted for both comfort and style. Nestled among magnolia trees, this prime location offers the best of San Francisco just moments from the Civic Center Farmers Market, renowned museums, and an ever-evolving food scene. With secure parking and elevator access, this is City living at its best!
